articleTitle: Sources of RF Intermodulation Distortion in Silicon Photonic Modulators
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We present a model of intermodulation distortion (IMD) in RF silicon photonic modulators to highlight mechanisms that limit the device linearity. We compare the SFDR of two MZMs to show a common IMD limitation and indicate methods to improve linearity in silicon photonic RF modulators.

articleTitle: High-Power, Efficient DFB Laser Technology for RF Photonics Links
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We present a high power DFB laser technology, developed for operation at 1280nm and 1550nm, showing >250mW laser output power and laser efficiencies up to 36%.

articleTitle: Frequency Agile Photonic Front-End for Wideband Transmission and Reception
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We have developed and tested a 0-45 GHz frequency agile photonic front-end for up- and down-conversion of signals with >800 MHz instantaneous bandwidth, <;1 us switching speed, and low end-to-end latency. The 3U OpenVPX system has been tested in a TRL6 demonstration.

articleTitle: A Novel Comb-Optimized (COMBO) DBR Laser
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We describe a novel approach to design of DBR lasers that utilizes sampled gratings to optimize mirror loss and mirror bandwidth independently. This versatile new approach has enabled a wide variety of lasers, from compact low power consumption to high power single mode designs.

articleTitle: High Speed, Low Power Photonic C-MOSFETs for Sub-14nm ULSI Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: microwave photonics; integrated optics; optical communication equipment; integrated optoelectronics; fibre optic sensors; optical losses; optical links; elemental semiconductors; silicon; optical modulation.

articleTitle: Linear Ring Modulators with DC Kerr Phase Shifters
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon ring modulator with linear phase shift versus voltage, derived from the interplay between plasma dispersion effect and DC Kerr effect. The dynamic range is 103.6 dB. Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup> at a 1.2 GHz carrier.

articleTitle: Develop RF-Photonic Technology for Wideband Spectrum Analyses
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We are developing new RF-Photonic technologies to provide fast wideband RF spectrum analyses up to 100GHz. These include an analog time-domain auto-correlation processer technique which provides an "instant picture" of the RF spectrum and a stimulated Brillouin scattering-based fast scanning RF spectrum analyzer.

articleTitle: Large Bandwidth Channelized RF Receiver Based on Chirped Pulses Mixing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: For military and civilian applications, the ultra-wideband Radio Frequency (RF) receiver is in great demand. As the development and requirement in near future, a very receiver which can handle frequency carrier ranging tens of GHz is urgently desired [1]. Also considering that the electronic circuit receiver combined a mixer and analog to digital converter(ADC) has to filtering the extra signal at the back end [2], it is essential to provide a means to channelize the broadband signal spectrum into frequency channels of which bandwidths are compatible with digital electronics [3].

articleTitle: Quasicoherent Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We present simulations of various envelope detection based quasicoherent receivers. These receivers provide sensitivity improvements of up to 18dB over direct detect receivers, while having a much simpler architecture compared to the classical coherent receiver.

articleTitle: High-Density 12 Transmitters Plus 12 Receivers Rugged Optical Fiber Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: Reflex Photonics Inc. has developed compact 168G full duplex (12+12) 14.025Gbps/lane optical fiber transceivers for harsh environment applications such as Aerospace and Defense. These devices are designed to be embedded on printed-circuit boards in close proximity to high speed electronics in high performance embedded computing systems to optimize their performance [1,2]. The same transceivers can also be integrated in board edge connectors to free-up more space on the board and avoid optical fiber management. The active blind-mate optical connector interface associated to the board edge mount application is based on the OpenVPX™ standards [3]. These standards define interfaces between plug-in modules, backplane modules and chassis for products intended to be deployed in harsh environments.

articleTitle: SAE Fiber Optics and Applied Photonics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: This is a status of activities for the SAE Aerospace Division Fiber Optics and Applied Photonics Committee.

articleTitle: Flexible Polymer Waveguide Technology for Low-Cost In-Car and In-Plane Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: Flexible polymer multimode waveguides are a promising low-cost technology for achieving high-speed optical interconnection in next-generation automobiles and aircrafts. Here, an overview of the light transmission performance of such waveguides is presented, achieving low loss, low crosstalk, high bandwidth and robust operation under strong flexure.

articleTitle: Compact 7-Channel SiN Wavelength De-multiplexer with Multi-core Fiber Fan-out
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We have demonstrated a compact and low-loss, cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometer based 7-channels wavelength de-multiplexer realized on a SiN platform over C-band with a multi-core fiber fan-out. The measured insertion loss and channel cross-talk are found below 0.5 dB and -8 dB for all the channels.

articleTitle: Counter Directional Optical Network using Ribbon Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: This ring optical network concept is meant for smaller platforms incorporating a source module and transmit/receive nodes. Source signals arise from a source bank. To transmit, a source fiber is connected with a receiving fiber in a node. The signal is modulated and then travels in the reverse direction. There is substantial flexibility in the source signal type, individual fiber type, none-to-node protocol, and modulation type.

articleTitle: Design of 3D Printed Integrated Multiplexer of Spatial Domain Multiplexing Communication System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: This presents spatial multiplexing in optical fiber communication systems, using a novel high resolution 3D printed multiplexer, which is designed with the help of Solid Works and Zemax. Simulated and experimental results for a two channel SDM system and their output intensity profile is presented.

articleTitle: Single-Sideband Thin Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN™) Electro-optic Modulators for RF over Fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: A high speed thin film lithium niobate modulator device is integrated with a Bragg grating for in situ sideband filtering. The configuration has potential for high efficiency linear intensity modulation at bandwidths exceeding 70 GHz. This proof of concept study explores the benefits of in situ versus ex situ processing and examines the differences in nonlinear optical models for this case where the traditional Jacobi-Anger expansion model for phase modulation is no longer true.

articleTitle: GHz-Band RF Receiver and Spectrometer Based on Laser Speckle in Multimode Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We report the experimental demonstrations of compressive sensing RF receiver and spectrometer with photonic systems in which the measurement matrices are implemented using speckle in multimode waveguides. We calibrate by measuring a dictionary of single frequency RF sinusoids and recover multiple tones with both systems.

articleTitle: Analog Photonic Timing Equalization Method for Multi-Channel RF Photonic Links
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: A new photonic timing equalization approach is presented to compensate the group delay among multiple signals in an analog photonic link. The results show the group delay variation across multiple RF photonic channels can be significantly compensated with 96.2% reduction after the equalization.

articleTitle: Surface Mounted Fiber Optic Sensors for Accurate Monitoring of Pressure Profiles Across an Airfoil
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We present a low profile surface mounted fiber optic pressure sensor for monitoring pressure profiles across an airfoil surface. The device has been tested on a symmetric airfoil section in a wind tunnel and shows excellent agreement with standard pressure taps.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Shaping for VCSEL-MMF Links
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We analyse the benefits of probabilistic shaping in reducing received power requirements in error-free VCSEL-MMF links. Experimental results demonstrate nearly 1 dB reduction for the same net data rate. All results are through 100m of OM5 fiber at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> SER.

articleTitle: Micro-Structured Fiber as Temperature Sensor in a Loop Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: A temperature sensor built by a micro-structured fiber (MSF) into a Sagnac interferometer scheme is reported. The optical waveguide is provided by a two-hole fiber (THF) which are located asymmetrically from the core. A linear response to thermal effects is observed and the sensitivity ~ 2.22 nm/°C was reached using a 2m-long of THF. The main advantage of the system proposed is a linear response, the use of a MSF with a simpler transverse geometry, non-use a special filled mechanism for the holes and a simple experimental array.

articleTitle: Gain, SFDR and NF for Analog Links with Arbitary Transfer Functions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE Avionics and Vehicle Fiber-Optics and Photonics Conference (AVFOP)
abstract: We present general expressions for RF gain, spurious free dynamic range and noise figure for analog links with arbitrary transmittances. We apply these to links comprised of simulated and fabricated integrated modulators.
